# Vendored writing assets

`hanzi-writer.min.js` is Hanzi Writer 3.5, distributed under the MIT license.
The character JSON files come from `hanzi-writer-data` 2.0. They are derived from Make Me a Hanzi data and are distributed under the Arphic Public License.

Sources:

- https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer

- https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi
